meta.title: Project Overview Page: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that access to the Project Overview Page is refused or absent.
Repeat the same Project Overview action as a Buyer and compare the result in the same tenant.
Verify the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to roles other than Buyer.
